chapter_title: Chương 44: Kích nhẹ một cái, đại gia lại nạp tiền

segments.title: Chương 44: Kích nhẹ một cái, đại gia lại nạp tiền
segments.content:
"Gang-ge, Zone 1 is lagging again!"

"Didn't the players who were just watching leave?"

"I don't know either."

"Post a game announcement. Guide the low-level players in Zone 1 to transfer to other zones."

"..."

At around 8:30 in the evening, Zone 1 started lagging again.

Immediately after, the other five zones, including the newly opened Zone 6, also gradually filled up.

Chen Guiliang carefully checked the latest replies on the forum and logged into an alternate account to read the in-game chat. He quickly figured out what was going on.

It turned out that new players were successively transferring over from other private servers like Dudu Legend and 17577 Legend.

In fact, many private server players had already heard last night that Abyss Legend was very interesting and wanted to try it out. But the download link was down at the time, so many could only wait until today to play.

These players had already swarmed in this afternoon.

And the players who had pulled an all-nighter running dungeons last night had now slept their fill and were also logging into the game.

The number of internet cafe players was also increasing.

With several waves of players colliding, how could it not lag?

"It's not lagging too badly, you can still barely play," Yang Yuhui said.

Tao Chenggang said, "We still need to rent more servers."

Chen Guiliang said, "Give the whale players free game boosters. Don't announce it, don't even tell the whale players. They'll be able to figure it out for themselves."

Just then, Tao Chenggang's phone rang.

He ran to a corner to answer it, and after a few sentences, he waved at Chen Guiliang.

Chen Guiliang walked over and asked, "What's wrong?"

Tao Chenggang said, "Luo Xiaoping, the guy who made the 'Dungeon Manager' for us, didn't he bring a friend to work on it with him? Our private server blew up, and his friend went to the forums to show off. Now everyone knows they made the Dungeon Manager, and many people are contacting them to buy it, wanting to jump on the bandwagon and make a private server with dungeons."

"That friend is probably just himself, isn't it?" Chen Guiliang suspected the worst of people.

"Definitely not," Tao Chenggang said. "Luo Xiaoping is still very reliable. He often shares the private server tools he develops for free. So many people have asked to buy the Dungeon Manager, but he hasn't agreed to any of them yet. Instead, he called me first to discuss it."

Chen Guiliang considered it for a moment and said, "We spent ten days just tuning the data to make our private server good. You can agree to let him sell it, just treat it as making a friend. Those copycat dungeon private servers, if they go online in two or three days, their playability will definitely be far worse than ours. If they drag it out for ten days before launching, it won't affect us much either, because Shanda would have already made a move against us by then."

Tao Chenggang redialed the number, chatted for a bit, and hung up. "He plans to set the price at ten thousand. With such a high price, probably only a few companies will buy it."

Chen Guiliang said, "We don't know which day Shanda will make its move, so we have to hurry and make some quick money. Announce the siege of Shabak for tomorrow at 8 PM. Applications for eligibility can start now. That will stimulate those players to run more dungeons for gear!"

A few minutes after the game announcement was sent out.

Boss Shi stood directly in the safe zone and shouted, "Guild recruiting! Only accepting players level 28 and above. Get 3 Abyss Tickets for joining, plus a weekly salary of 5 tickets. Join now, first come, first served! We're farming all night tonight to take Shabak tomorrow night!"

Jing-ye Fu Guogiang was stunned. He had planned to recruit people the same way. But he was only going to give one ticket for joining and a weekly salary of two tickets.

"Who the hell is that son of a bitch? So rich!" Fu Guogiang couldn't help but curse.

An old buddy in his party said, "I recognize his lackey, an old ID from Legend. The one who just shouted might be the boss of Nao Baijin."

"Fuck! How are we supposed to compete for Shabak now?"

"Qiang-ge, why don't we switch zones? We can't outspend them."

"Switch my ass! Was last night's all-nighter for nothing? This private server doesn't sell equipment, and Abyss Tickets are only 5 yuan each. No matter how much money he spends, he can't create that big of a gap."

"Qiang-ge, are you planning to go all in?"

"Whatever benefits he's offering to recruit people, I can offer them too. You guys shout to recruit people, I'll go top up a few more thousand yuan."

"Yeah, let's fuck over Nao Baijin! I've been sick of his ads for a long time!"

Old Wang thought it was awesome, Old Shi thought it was hot...

"..."

For the sake of tomorrow night's Shabak siege, the whale players in all six zones began an arms race.

The amount of top-ups instantly soared!

This, in turn, boosted the motivation of the vast number of free-to-play players and those who spent a small amount of money. They flocked to join guilds, got dungeon tickets from the whale players, and then happily ran dungeons in guild mode.

Xie Yang stood behind the top-up customer service, watching the transaction records scroll by. His eyes nearly popped out of his head.

This money was so easy to make.

The players were very wild on Saturday night.

Even wilder would be the Shabak siege tomorrow night.

As more and more internet cafes proactively contacted them for partnerships, Tao Chenggang opened a seventh zone on Sunday afternoon.

"Gang-ge, we're heading back to school first," Chen Guiliang said after lunch.

"Alright. Focus on your studies, don't let them slide."

Tao Chenggang took out two hundred yuan and handed it to Xie Yang. "Thanks for your help, little brother."

Xie Yang quickly refused, "Mr. Tao, really, you don't have to. I just helped post a few threads and chatted on QQ a bit when customer service was busy."

"Take it. We'll have more chances to cooperate in the future," Tao Chenggang said with a smile.

Xie Yang turned to look at Chen Guiliang.

"Take it," Chen Guiliang said.

Only then did Xie Yang accept the money, a little shyly. "Thank you, Mr. Tao."

In a small city where the average monthly salary was only a few hundred yuan, getting a huge red envelope of two hundred yuan for just helping out a little for two days was a rare thing for a poor student.

After Tao Chenggang left the small restaurant, Xie Yang dragged Chen Guiliang to the bathroom. "Mr. Tao is really generous."

"He is indeed," Chen Guiliang smiled.

Giving two hundred yuan was, of course, out of respect for Chen Guiliang.

The other customer service reps and paid posters all received a monthly salary plus a small bonus.

They weren't in a hurry on the way back to school, so Chen Guiliang, Xie Yang, and Tao Xue chose to take the inter-county bus.

Tao Xue was the first to grab a window seat and waved at Chen Guiliang. "Come quick, big nephew!"

"Alright, Auntie Xue." Chen Guiliang was in a good mood from making money and gave Tao Xue a nickname on the spot.

Tao Xue pondered, "Why does that form of address sound so familiar? I feel like I've heard it somewhere."

Xie Yang burst out laughing, "Romance in the Rain."

Tao Xue suddenly realized and punched Chen Guiliang's shoulder. "That sounds awful! I don't want to be called Auntie Xue."

"Alright, Auntie Xue," Chen Guiliang said it with even more glee.

"Bastard, I'm going to kill you!"

Tao Xue flew into a rage, grabbing Chen Guiliang's neck with both hands and shaking him vigorously.

Chen Guiliang cooperated fully by rolling his eyes and sticking out his tongue, looking like he had already been strangled to death.

Xie Yang sat in the adjacent seat across the aisle, watching them fooling around. He thought to himself: Which one is Great Hero Chen going to choose? Bian Guanyue is prettier, but Tao Xue is so cute. Damn, if it were me, I wouldn't be able to choose either. I can't just draw lots to decide, can I?

The three of them took the bus to the county bus station, then transferred to a public bus back to school.

After getting off the bus, Chen Guiliang ran straight to a pharmacy by the road.

Tao Xue thought he was going to buy some medicine, but when she followed him, she found Chen Guiliang weighing himself.

"I only gained two jin this week. Looks like I've been working too hard," Chen Guiliang reflected seriously.

Tao Xue said irritably, "You ran to a pharmacy just to weigh yourself?"

"What else?" Chen Guiliang said.

Xie Yang stood at the pharmacy entrance, too lazy to follow them in, and complained, "I'm used to it. This son of a bitch comes to weigh himself every two or three days."

Laughing and talking, the three walked onto campus. Near the spot where Chen Guiliang used to sell books, they waved goodbye and went their separate ways to their dorms and apartment.

It was still quite early, and there was no one in dorm room 302. The other six roommates had not yet returned to school.

Xie Yang sprawled on his bed and said, "Now that I'm suddenly back at school, the past two days feel like a dream."

Chen Guiliang also lay down on his bed. "What are your thoughts?"

"I don't dare to think," Xie Yang said, filled with emotion. "Rich people are just too rich. They top up thousands and thousands of yuan just to buy dungeon tickets. A few more top-ups, and they could buy a house in the county town."

An old unit in a staff apartment building in the county town only cost twenty to thirty thousand yuan!

"Are you still going to play the game?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Xie Yang seemed to have kicked his gaming addiction in an instant. He said, "Playing games is boring. I want to be the one who makes games for others to play. Great Hero Chen, are you planning to start a company with Mr. Tao in the future?"

"I can't cooperate with him. Even if we did, we'd fall out sooner or later," Chen Guiliang said, shaking his head.

Xie Yang said, "Mr. Tao is a very straightforward person. He seems like a good business partner."

Chen Guiliang said, "He and I are the same type of person. He wasn't even willing to partner with Boss Shi, so will he listen to my decisions in the future? Once we disagree on a major issue, we won't be able to play happily together anymore."

"So if he wants to make games on his own, you won't participate?" Xie Yang asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "I don't have the capital right now. He would definitely be the controlling shareholder."

Xie Yang said, "You could still take some shares. When the company gets big, you could sell your shares and start your own business."

Chen Guiliang said, "A founding shareholder's shares can't be sold casually. You need the approval of more than half of the other shareholders. And he'll have to seek investment, so my shares would be diluted. Whether I sell my shares or my shares get diluted, it could create a whole bunch of conflicts."

Xie Yang opened his mouth but stopped, not knowing what to say, because he really didn't understand any of this.

Suddenly, he rolled over and got up. Xie Yang walked to the dorm room door and said, "Going to the classroom?"

"What for?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Xie Yang said, "To study. I'll get into a good university first. I've realized I don't know anything. These past two days, when you guys were talking, I often couldn't get a word in, just standing there like an idiot. I don't want to be an idiot, and I'm not an idiot."

Chen Guiliang didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "So you're really not going to play games anymore?"

"It feels pretty boring to play now," Xie Yang said.

Chen Guiliang didn't comment. Who knew how long this guy could last? Maybe in two or three days, Xie Yang would be running off to the internet cafe again.

"I'm off!"

Xie Yang flicked his hair with an incredibly suave motion and disappeared from the doorway.
